svg.metadata: OpenStreetMap-derived San Marino boundary via Geo2day, retrieved 2026-09-02; WGS84; illustrated treatment: JOURNEY ATLAS

g.desc: GSHHG 2.3.6 intermediate-resolution sampling covers the entire aspect-fitted viewport as continuous inland land. San Marino is surrounded by Italian territory; the pale full-frame context therefore represents surrounding foreign land while the approved San Marino target remains dominant and unchanged.
